title: Capstone: differentiate next week's lesson
goal: Make and check a 3-tier worksheet for a real lesson you're teaching next week.

blocks.title: Bring it all together
blocks.body:
Last one. Think of a real topic you're actually teaching next week.

Make the tiers, then check them like the expert you now are — do they truly differ, are they levelled right, do they fit your class? That whole loop, on your own, is the skill you came for.

blocks.scaffold: Make a {{artifact}} on [next week's topic] for my {{gradeBand}} {{subject}} class, in 3 tiers (support, core, stretch) with an answer key.
